body:
> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Answering the review bodies by finding title. Every finding in them is also an inline thread, and each was checked against the top of the stack (`feature/ready-copy-in-library`). All of them still apply there, and each will be answered in its own thread with the fix commit.

- **github-actions[bot] review 5720294546:**
  - Batch 1, "disable Pick from Library while an import is running": confirmed, fix pending (thread 4429748978).
  - Batch 2, "GitHub size bar label", "picker focus" and "running row in Recent exports": confirmed, fixes pending (threads 4429748982, 4429748987, 4429748990).
  - Batch 4, "Library drop test passes regardless": confirmed, fix pending (thread 4429748993).
  - Batch 5, "with and without a video" and "badge in-progress count untested": confirmed, fixes pending (threads 4429748997, 4429749000).
  - Batch 6, "orphaned `.importZone` comment": confirmed at `library-page.module.css:108`, fix pending (thread 4429749002).
  - Batch 3 had no findings.
- **pullfrog[bot] review 5720296552**, "Export never re-reads the Library when that copy finishes": confirmed. `export-page.tsx` never calls `refresh()` on `runner.ready`, and `if (isLoading)` would unmount the screen on a re-list. The fix is pending in thread 4429750768.
